name: Nimb Hotel
positioning: Boutique hotel in a 1909 Moorish-inspired palace in the heart of Copenhagen, owned by and looking onto Tivoli Gardens
best_for: Travelers who want Tivoli Gardens on the doorstep, with unlimited entries and rides
Guests who value a hammam spa and a rooftop pool in a central city hotel

facts.text: Nimb is in the heart of Copenhagen and offers views to the Tivoli Gardens amusement park.
Nimb is right by Copenhagen's central station.
Nimb is owned by Tivoli Gardens.
In 2007 the building underwent a massive update and reopened as a luxury boutique hotel.
The rooms and suites are uniquely decorated.
The rooms' look pairs Nordic minimalism with Asian opulence.
Nimb Wellness is a 300-square-metre area with a hammam, a steam area and a relaxation area with free refreshments.
Hotel guests have free access to Nimb Wellness, including the fitness studio, hammam and relaxation area.
The wellness area offers cardio training in a specially designed 34-degree hot room.
Nimb Brasserie serves French cuisine morning, noon and evening.
Nimb Bar serves cocktails and afternoon tea under chandeliers.

highlights.text: Hotel guests get unlimited entries and rides at Tivoli Gardens.
The roof terrace has an emerald green pool where you can swim against a built-in tide, with a view of Copenhagen and Tivoli Gardens.
The hotel is housed in a 1909 Moorish-inspired palace.
At the heart of Nimb Wellness is a vaulted Moroccan hammam with a 50-degree steam bath.
Each evening, turndown service brings sweet treats, foot baths and face masks to the bedside.

considerations.text: Not all rooms are wheelchair accessible, although all floors are served by an elevator; ask the booking team when reserving.
The minimum age for the wellness facilities is 16, though younger children with an adult are welcome in the hammam and relaxation area.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the exclusive location and luxury positioning.
